title: Hi, I'm {{name}}
aboutText:
Frontend and Mobile Engineer with 6+ years of experience building fintech, crypto and digital products across web and mobile using React, React Native, Next.js and TypeScript. Currently working as a Freelance - Contractor, I collaborate with companies on production applications, greenfield products and end-to-end feature delivery.

I use AI-assisted engineering workflows for technical research, implementation, refactoring, testing, documentation and rapid prototyping, always reviewing the final output for quality and maintainability.
bioFallback: I build web and mobile products focused on performance, scalability, and clean UX.

items.role: React / React Native / Next.js / AI Engineer | Freelance - Contractor
items.summary: Working as an independent React, React Native, Next.js and AI Engineer, collaborating with companies across fintech, crypto and digital products.
overview: Contribute to mobile and web applications, from greenfield projects and end-to-end feature implementation to maintenance and improvement of production applications.
Apply AI-assisted engineering workflows and explore AI-powered capabilities to accelerate development, improve problem-solving and support product experimentation.

clients.name: BITNOVO / BITSA / B4BIT
highlights: Developing and shipping production features across the Bitnovo Wallet and Bitsa applications, working on different areas and user flows.
Refactoring and improving existing codebases, enhancing maintainability, resolving technical issues and evolving existing features.
Building and architecting the B4bit MVP from the ground up as a greenfield React Native application, establishing its core architecture and technical foundations.
Collaborating closely with product, design and engineering teams to deliver new features, improve existing flows and continuously enhance the overall application experience.

clients.name: STABLE.IO
highlights: Wallet: maintained and developed features for buying, selling, converting and sending cryptocurrencies.
IPP: contributed to the development of a new greenfield MVP built from scratch, implementing features end-to-end.

clients.name: RECODME
highlights: PadelPool: contributed to building the mobile application from scratch.
InvertyApp: worked on the application's complete rebranding and implementation of its new user experience.

clients.name: BANCO EXTERIOR VENEZUELA
clients.description: supported the development of Banco Exterior's new home banking platform, contributing to an existing project undergoing a broader renewal.

technologies.label: Main technologies
technologies.description: React Native, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, TanStack Query, REST APIs, Axios, Redux, Zustand, LLM, RAG, Firebase, Next.js, Git and GitHub.

items.summary: Developed and evolved Ripio mobile products, focusing on wallet experiences, crypto operations and reusable UI components.
highlights: TAG: developed and maintained a simplified method for sending and receiving cryptocurrencies.
Access/Core: developed KYC and Wallet access flows, resolved bugs and evolved existing features.
Himalaya Design System: created a centralized reusable component library to unify the interface, reduce duplication and streamline development.
RipioTrade: implemented an end-to-end product for buying, selling and swapping cryptocurrencies, integrating BitcoinTrade and supporting a high volume of operations.

items.summary: Developed and optimized mobile fintech products, focusing on the cryptocurrency experience.
highlights: Crypto: developed and evolved features for cryptocurrency operations within the mobile application.
Performance: refactored and optimized the React Native application to improve performance and maintainability.
Web: provided targeted support for refactoring and improving web projects.

items.summary: Contributed to InvertirOnline's web rebranding and the greenfield development of its new mobile brokerage application.
highlights: Mobile: built the brokerage application from scratch as part of the mobile team, using React Native and Node.js.
Web/Rebranding: implemented HTML and CSS landing pages to introduce InvertirOnline's new visual identity.
Frontend: maintained and refactored internal React applications and created reusable components.

items.summary: Developed and evolved an internal CRM used to access and manage customer information.
highlights: Refactoring: improved an existing React application to increase maintainability and support the evolution of new features.
CRM: developed internal views and flows for retrieving centralized customer information through a unique identifier.
Analysis: gathered requirements and resolved issues in collaboration with internal teams.

items.summary: Developed web products for a healthcare platform connecting patients with medical professionals.
highlights: Landing pages: created wireframes and implemented pages presenting UMA's rebranding and products.
PWA: developed a React application connecting patients and doctors.
Real-time chat: implemented and maintained messaging flows and real-time response handling.
Support: resolved production issues reported by doctors and patients.
